question: Which of the following is 'George David Roberts’ thriller novel that is based on his own experience in Mumbai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shantaram.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Shantaram in Gregory David Roberts' 2003 thriller novel Shantaram, a heroin addict and convicted bank robber from Australia escapes from Pentridge Prison and makes his way to India.**
 
• Many praise the book for its vivid depiction of the turbulent life in Bombay in the early to late 1980s.
